title: Square Jacobi SVD HDL Optimized
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/Square_Jacobi_SVD_HDL_Optimized.md
text: Fixed-point singular value decomposition, 4 inputs, 5 outputs, {Select outputs} sets Block outputs; {Dimension of matrix A} sets the dimension of square matrix, {Number of Jacobi iterations} sets the number of iterations of Jacobi algorithm and {Signal type} sets the complexity of input matrix. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Square matrix A real or complex square matrix

ports.name: readyIn
ports.summary: Whether downstream block is ready scalar

ports.name: restart
ports.summary: Whether to clear internal states scalar

ports.name: U
ports.summary: Left singular vectors unitary n -by- n matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: Right singular vectors unitary n -by- n matrix

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Whether output data is valid Boolean scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Whether block is ready Boolean scalar

params.name: Dimension of matrix A
params.values: Dimension of square matrix A n (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of Jacobi iterations
params.values: Number of iterations of Jacobi algorithm 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Select outputs
params.values: Block outputs UsV (default) | Us | sV | s

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Complexity of input matrix A real (default) | complex
